{{ 'search-component.css' | asset_url | stylesheet_tag }}
<form action="/search" method="get" role="search" class="search-form">
  <label for="SearchInput" class="visually-hidden">{{ 'general.search.label' | t }}</label>
  <input type="search" id="SearchInput" name="q" placeholder="{{ 'general.search.placeholder' | t }}">
  <button type="submit" aria-label="{{ 'general.search.submit' | t }}">
    {% render 'icon-search' %}
  </button>
</form>
